summary: Checked all 14 estimates against the saved 33-page PDF after reading the entire markdown conversion, including references and Appendix A. Opened every page cited by the estimates and checked the methods, counts, arm identities, analysis scope, coding, and exclusions. Recovered Tables 8 and 15 with PyMuPDF find_tables and checked their column assignments. All recorded statistics and counts match the PDF. No additional eligible full-sample outcome or contrast was found under extraction rules 4-6. All eight supplied script flags are false positives. The six text_features measures are explicitly allowed by the current creativity-codebook.md, section 6, and fit the tagged linguistic-feature counts described in PDF p. 9 (printed p. 410:9), Table 3. PDF p. 32 (printed p. 410:32), Table 15, prints a dash in the HAI vs. Human column for both Length and Root clauses. Their quotations correctly combine the row label with the selected cell as extraction rule 2 permits; other columns intervene in flattened PDF text. The dash-only statistics appropriately remain null. The study-level 103 writers is directly printed on PDF p. 2; the 401 HAI-vs.-Human pair evaluations is directly printed on PDF p. 14 and is not used as a writer count. Missing analysis-specific people counts and unspecified Table 8 aggregation units remain null. The unclear and output-level uncertainty codes preserve the paper's limitations. Distinct-2 and type-token ratio are conservatively retained as vocabulary variety, since computation across people is not established. SMOG is explicitly described as a readability/quality proxy; its null measure is accompanied by the documented gap in the supplied measure vocabulary. The excluded model-only contrasts, selected draft-final comparisons, country subgroups, self-reports, process outcomes, and adjustments for post-treatment length do not supply missing eligible estimates.
